subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

fictitious
solution: The correct answer is '**imaginary**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**fictitious**' is '**imaginary**'. • **Fictitious**: invented; not real. (मनगढ़ंत; बनावटी) • *Example: The novel is set in a **fictitious** village called Gangapur.* • **Imaginary**: existing only in the mind; not real. (केवल मन में, काल्‍पनिक; अवास्‍तविक) • *Example: Many children have **imaginary** friends.* • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.** **Correct Answer:__** *imaginary.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Factual**: based on or containing things that are true or real. (तथ्‍यों पर आधारित) • **Confirmed**: fixed in a particular habit or way of life. [(आदत या जीवन-शैली) न बदली जा सकने वाली; पक्‍की, स्‍थायी] • **Genuine**: real; true. (वास्‍तविक; असली) e6:T5da, The correct answer is** 'in serving'.**
